The unwrappable231.6px CTA shares a262/292px flex row with a zero-minimum growing text column. Title becomes C/Co ellipsis and reason/track wrap into tiny fragments. Actual full-page images and fresh five-width browser bounds corroborate.
findings.rootCause: The flex child with min-width0 can shrink to nearly zero, so flex-wrap does not move the CTA; title truncate hides the lesson.
findings.fix: Stack text and CTA below640px; retain side-by-side wide layout and allow full title wrapping. Preserve recommendation/progress logic, text, CTA and destination.
findings.risk: Low layout-only classes on one Learn card; no progress load/save/recommendation, account, auth, financial, DB, privacy, consent, ad or infrastructure behavior change.
findings.rollback: Reviewed UI-only revert through serial protected exact-native/live release cycle. No data operation.
findings.adsenseRelevance: Readability/navigation clarity; no specific policy violation asserted.

investigations.protectedBoundary: No currency conversion, fees, positions or history changes without explicit owner approval. A precise display-only scope clarification can be investigated independently.
